definition: existing in large amounts; more than enough
example: The garden had an abundant harvest of tomatoes this summer.

definition: lacking courage or confidence; easily frightened
example: The timid kitten hid under the bed when guests arrived.

definition: not wanting to do something; hesitant
example: Sam was reluctant to jump into the cold pool.

definition: easily broken or damaged
example: Wrap the fragile vase carefully so it doesn't crack.

definition: not occupied or filled
example: The vacant lot next to school was full of weeds.

definition: to keep out of sight or keep secret
example: She tried to conceal the surprise gift behind her back.

definition: dull, dark, and depressing
example: The dreary, rainy day kept everyone indoors.

definition: lacking physical strength or force
example: The feeble old dog could barely climb the stairs.

definition: done too quickly, without enough thought
example: His hasty answer had a careless mistake in it.

definition: showing good manners and respect
example: The courteous student held the door open for everyone.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
example: The explorers crossed a vast desert that stretched for miles.

definition: serious risk of harm
example: The sailors were in great peril during the storm.

definition: belonging to the very distant past; very old
example: We saw ancient Egyptian tools at the museum.

definition: (verb) to politely say no to
example: Maya had to decline the party invitation because of her recital.

definition: truthful and direct; frank
example: Coach gave a candid opinion about how our team could improve.

definition: extremely careful about every small detail
example: The meticulous artist spent hours painting each tiny feather.

definition: well-meaning and generous; wanting to help others
example: The benevolent neighbor shoveled snow for everyone on the street.

definition: difficult to find, catch, or pin down
example: The elusive fox always slipped away before we could take its picture.

definition: showing steady, careful effort
example: Because she was diligent about practicing, her piano skills improved quickly.

definition: pleasant, good-natured, and easy to like
example: The amiable new student made friends on his very first day.

definition: quick, lively, and energetic
example: We took a brisk walk to warm up before the game.

definition: careful to avoid danger or mistakes
example: The cautious driver slowed down on the icy road.

definition: completely wet
example: We were drenched after getting caught in the thunderstorm.

definition: thin and weak; easily broken
example: The flimsy umbrella flipped inside out in the wind.

definition: (verb) to hold tightly; also, to understand
example: Grasp the rope with both hands before you climb.

definition: something that could cause harm; a danger
example: The broken step was a hazard for anyone walking by.

definition: extremely large
example: An immense whale swam right beside our boat.

definition: slightly wet
example: Keep the soil moist so the seeds can sprout.

definition: (adjective) new and different from anything before
example: Mia had a novel idea for her science fair project.

definition: to think about something carefully
example: Luke paused to ponder the tricky math problem.

definition: extremely hungry
example: After practice the team was ravenous and ate three pizzas.

definition: in short supply; hard to find
example: Water was scarce during the long, dry summer.

definition: gracefully thin
example: The slender branch bent under the weight of the bird.

definition: bright and strong in color; clear and lively
example: She painted the sunset in vivid oranges and reds.

definition: very tired, especially after hard work
example: The weary hikers rested at the top of the hill.

definition: having more than one possible meaning; not clear
example: The directions were so ambiguous that half the class got lost.

definition: refusing to give up; holding on firmly
example: The tenacious goalie blocked shot after shot.

definition: not serious; of little importance
example: He spent his allowance on frivolous toys he never played with.

definition: showing good judgment; sensible and careful
example: It was prudent to bring a raincoat when the sky looked dark.

definition: not interested or concerned either way
example: The cat seemed indifferent to the new toy we bought it.
